race.comment: PAW WALDO (1) was below best at his last start when 7th at this track following a win (16.86) there two back. Has a good record here at this journey. The form from his last run stacks up well. Ready to return to form. BULA (6) was quickly into stride and burnt early from out wide where he gave a sight, finishing third (16.91) and beaten 3 lengths over 300m at this track. Expecting another good run. ANGRY CHIEF (2) hit the ground running off the low draw last start and was never headed (25.62) at Ballarat in a Grade 5 over 450m. Remains without a win from the draw but has been in the placings eight times from 13 attempts. Bold showing expected again. MIGHTY MIKADO (7) has ability and finds the right scenario to bounce back.
